description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a mossy glade floor inside a ring of old stones: short grass and thick moss patches, flat grey stones half sunk in the ground, a few fern sprigs, muted dark palette of moss green and stone grey, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
